paragraphs: I'm applying for the Sr Analyst, Corporate Development role at PayPal in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Payments is changing fast, and I'd like to work on the questions of where a company like PayPal should build, buy or partner.

In my MBA coursework I valued J.M. Smucker with comps, built a DCF with WACC and sensitivity analysis checked against a sell-side model, and built an LBO while looking at packaged food M&A in Capital IQ. Before school, at Lenovo, I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at JPMorgan Asset Management I modeled $10M in marketing-channel budget allocation and wrote briefs for senior leadership.
I don't have live deal experience, but I can build a clean model, benchmark against peers, and turn the work into a clear recommendation. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for the Sr Analyst, Corporate Development role at PayPal. I've built DCF, comps and LBO models in my MBA coursework, and at Lenovo I built scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%. I'd love to hear how the team decides what to look at. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
